title: Slow jsonb containment queries without GIN index
symptoms: Table has jsonb column but no useful index
cause: Containment operators benefit from GIN (or expression) indexes; without them Postgres may scan all rows.
solution: CREATE INDEX ... USING GIN (payload jsonb_path_ops) or default jsonb_ops as appropriate; verify with EXPLAIN ANALYZE; extract hot keys to typed columns when filters are stable.
workaround: Filter on relational columns first to reduce rows before jsonb predicates.
